# Sticker Maker

Sticker maker: die-cut stickers of characters, pets, quotes and logos with a white border, kawaii or retro, generated ready to print or share.

## What it does
Describe the sticker and the style. Claude tells you the price and creates up to four designs per run.

**How the files are made:** each sticker is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Image files on a light background; cut lines are not included.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install sticker-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Sticker Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/sticker/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each sticker uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The stickers show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_sticker_models` | Models for stickers with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_sticker_cost` | Exact price of one sticker before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_sticker` | Starts one sticker in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_sticker` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A kawaii avocado doing yoga, sticker"
- "A retro sticker that says Stay Weird"
- "Four cat stickers with different moods"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the sticker (the subject and the style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
